findings.claim: mini-submodules reports a submodule as healthy merely because its directory is non-empty, without checking the required built artifacts.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1/proposal requires `mini-submodules` to verify “each gitlink present and built where applicable: `tools/openspec/dist`, `pk` binary resolvable”; the implementation only computes `empty = gitlinks.filter(...) readdirSync(dir).length === 0` and then returns pass when `empty.length === 0`.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend mini-submodules to validate the applicable build outputs for known gitlinks, e.g. check the pk binary/build artifact for `tools/prometheus-knowledge` and `tools/openspec/dist` when that gitlink exists, and fail or warn with the missing artifact named.

findings.claim: mini-sycophancy-correction treats any non-empty SYCOPHANCY_BIN value as an installed working binary even if the path does not exist.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 says `mini-sycophancy-correction` must resolve the binary via `PATH`/`SYCOPHANCY_BIN` and warn when absent; the default resolver is `process.env.SYCOPHANCY_BIN ?? resolveOnPath(...)`, and the check immediately returns pass with `summary: sycophancy-correction at ${binary}` without `existsSync`, `statSync`, or spawning the binary.
findings.suggested_fix: When SYCOPHANCY_BIN is set, verify that it names an existing executable file or run a harmless version probe; if it does not, report warn/absent or fail/misconfigured instead of pass.
